description:
This workflow diagram outlines the process for generating the ARLIE S1 + S2 geodatabase. The process begins with daily Water Ice Cloud (WIC) S1, WIC S2, or combined WIC S1+S2 products.
1. Each WIC product is intersected with EU-Hydro data.
2. Products covering a single EU-Hydro segment are merged.
3. Statistics and Quality Assurance (QA), specifically the `AWIC_confidence` calculated as the mean `WIC_confidence_level`, are computed for each EU-Hydro segment.
The process concludes with the creation of the ARLIE S1 + S2 geodatabase.
